title: OCPI 2.1.1 response envelope of PUT/PATCH /sessions/{session_id} with the end-user pricing extension

extensionData.description: Normally empty in standard OCPI. The extension fields ride here.

end_user_tariff.description: EXTENSION, optional. Send only when the tariff changed or when the authorize response could not carry it.

end_user_total_cost.description: EXTENSION. Cumulative, VAT-INCLUSIVE cost of the session to the driver, reflecting the session state in the request being answered. Mirrors the type of 2.1.1 Session.total_cost.

currency.description: EXTENSION. ISO 4217 code. REQUIRED when end_user_total_cost is present.
